bio: Hi, I'm Tonika, a hair stylist passionate about creating modern, personalized styles that enhance natural beauty and boost confidence. I specialize in working closely with each client to understand their vision and lifestyle, making sure every style is not only beautiful but also practical and easy to maintain.

policies.deposits: A non-refundable $25 deposit is required to secure your appointment. This amount will be applied toward your final balance. Remaining balance MUST be in Cash only.
policies.traveling: As a mobile service, a travel fee will be added. Rates may vary depending on location.
policies.delay: We allow a 15-minute grace period. After that, a late fee will apply or your appointment may need to be rescheduled.
policies.reschedule: Need to reschedule? Please notify us at least 48 hours in advance so we can accommodate you and offer your spot to another client.

before: Before your appointment, please ensure you're ready to begin at your scheduled time. This allows me to dedicate the full appointment to you, ensuring a smooth, relaxed, and unhurried experience without any unnecessary delays.
Bring any inspiration photos, reference styles, or ideas you love so we can fully understand your vision and personalize your look exactly to your preference.
Come with clean, dry hair that is free from heavy styling products, oils, or buildup to help us achieve the best possible results and flawless final finish.
If you need to reschedule or cancel your appointment, please notify us in advance to allow us to manage our schedule efficiently and accommodate other valued clients.
bookLede: Saturday and Sunday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Appointments run about 2 to 5 hours. Pick a start time that’s open. A non-refundable $25 deposit holds your spot and goes toward your balance. Remaining balance is cash only.
addressNote: Mobile service in British Columbia — enter the address for your appointment. A travel fee may apply depending on location.
hairNote: Add a photo or short video of your current hair length so Tonika can see if it’s long enough for the style you want.
inspoNote: Add a photo or video of the hairstyle you want — from your phone, a screenshot, or something you saved from Google.
thanksNote: Pick your service, and get ready to shine!
reminderNote: Text me a reminder 3 hours before my appointment with the day and time.
timeHint: Pick a start time during Saturday or Sunday hours. Appointments usually run 2 to 5 hours.
